assumptions.statement: The core Read-Back class maps retained-conditioned present current one-forms to a derived current-like one-form and obeys the passive null.
A fixed-topology live-edge space with stable edge order and declared positive edge metric supplies the local graph one-cochain domain; event crossings remain D8-D9 work.
D5 evaluates an unsolved trial current in the later total-current cochain space; only D6 may impose and solve the recurrent total-current relation.
W_A and W_hat share positive scalar edge units on the admitted A domain so their normalized contrast is dimensionless and orientation invariant.
The C operator is conditional on a regular positive h_M and typed h_4-to-h_M identification; D5 does not supply the missing H_M closure.
The current graph is treated as a one-dimensional cell complex for the displayed graph Hodge Laplacian; future higher-cell structure requires an explicit extension.
